customers.evidence: We work to make technology accessible to everyone, and our business model is ads so our services can be free.

dei.evidence: the makeup of our company reflects the diverse perspectives of the people who use our technologies

community.evidence: We have a responsibility to promote the best of what people can do together

safety.evidence: keeping people safe and preventing harm

innovation.evidence: we’re building innovative new ways to help people feel closer to each other

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, mission-led framing in first-person plural, centring connection and technology's social potential. Commitments are mostly absolute ('We have a responsibility'), while the connection claim is hedged ('when they're at their best'). Innovation and the metaverse dominate. Customers and community come first; employees, shareholders and environment are absent.
